title: Cafe Franchise Opportunity
name: Coffee Counter, 2 Franchisees, Est'd in 2021, Jabalpur HQ
description: Coffee Counter is a specialty beverage brand operating two successful outlets in Jabalpur, located in Hathital and the Home Science College area. - The cafes specialize in premium cold coffees, thick shakes, mocktails, and quick bites. - Each outlet has an average seating capacity for 15 customers. - The cafes are fully vegetarian. - The two outlets collectively attract approximately 30–40 daily walk-in customers. - The business is expanding to Mall 11 in Madan Mahal under a 100% FOCO model. - The business has FSSAI license and Udyam Registration Certificate.
